ID_definition: SHA256 of original English problem.strip() UTF-8, as in the existing dataset adapter; no question/solution/answer texts exported.
index_encoding: All index arrays below are zero-based positions in primary2700_original_IDs_in_input_order; array order is preserved.

ja.existing_JA_repair: Existing audited single-row literal Japanese prefix repair; no new modification.

data_audit_summary.normalization: Unicode NFKC plus whitespace normalization; case preserved.
data_audit_summary.stratification: source x English question character-length quartile x English reference character-length quartile
data_audit_summary.stratification_limit: Length strata are proxies, not verified mathematical difficulty or equal token costs; semantic near-duplicates are not exhaustively ruled out.
data_audit_summary.JA: Existing single-row literal-prefix repair remains a separately recorded project adaptation; no new edits.
data_audit_summary.TE_recovery: Accepted640 = retained checkpoint5 first160 + resumed480. Original failed attempt logged256 prompts;96 beyond retained checkpoint5 are discarded from accepted-training exposure budget, not erased or zero-charged computation.

scope: IDs-only data delivery. Primary2700 single models and matched900/sequential models remain separate cohorts. Teacher sees privileged English problem/reference, student target question; no target-language SFT labels are required. These provenance checks do not establish semantic translation/reference correctness, absence of all near-duplicates, general model efficacy or completion of pending formal tests. Original exact-English benchmark overlap audit is preserved; it is not relabeled an exhaustive semantic or new normalized-test audit.
